contract.label: Dialog
contract.summary: A modal dialog: a Trigger opens a portalled overlay + centered Content, with styled header/footer, title, description, and close.
contract.purpose: The centered modal for one short, focused action. It keeps a top-right close so a modal is always dismissible.
useWhen: A short create action of roughly one to four fields.
dontUseWhen: The form is long or dense — that is a right-side `sheet`.
The action is destructive or irreversible — that is an `alert-dialog`, which omits the close on purpose.

parts.name: Dialog
parts.description: Root managing the dialog's open state.

parts.name: DialogContent
parts.description: Portalled, centered popup with an optional close button.

parts.name: DialogDescription
parts.description: Muted supporting text under the title.

parts.name: DialogHeader
parts.description: Styled div stacking the title and description.

parts.name: DialogOverlay
parts.description: Fixed dimmed backdrop behind the dialog.

parts.name: DialogPortal
parts.description: Renders the dialog outside the DOM tree.

parts.name: DialogTitle
parts.description: Styled heading text for the dialog.

parts.name: DialogTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the dialog on click.

requires: A `DialogTitle`; it is the modal's accessible name, visually hidden if the design shows none.
forbids: Moving the close elsewhere, or hand-rolling a modal without one.
An inline scrim colour; the scrim is the `scrim` token.
rules: Short create actions (1–4 fields). Longer or dense edit forms go to a right `sheet` at 420px.
**Always keeps its top-right close (X).** Never `showCloseButton={false}` — only `alert-dialog` omits it.

behavior.destructive: A destructive confirmation is not this component — it is `alert-dialog`.

requirements: Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close. Base UI does this; don't defeat it.
A surface opened from inside a dialog — a `select`, a `popover` — is a later portal sibling and paints above it without a new z-index.

antiPatterns: A twelve-field form in a dialog that should have been a sheet.
A non-destructive modal with the close removed.
